forms.name: Bolt
forms.text: A bolt that bursts on the first foe it hits. Each later move of a chain hits harder and bursts wider.

forms.name: Volley
forms.text: Homing darts that seek out different foes: three, or five from a heavy move or a hold charged past its first stage.

forms.name: Lance

melee.text: A lunge along the line, striking every foe you pass. Each later move of a chain hits harder.

forms.text: An instant line that hits every foe along it. Each later move of a chain reaches further and hits harder.

forms.name: Burst

melee.text: You slam the ground and it erupts where you aim, within 5 units. Each later move of a chain is bigger.

forms.text: An explosion where you aim. Each later move of a chain is bigger.

forms.name: Strike
forms.text: An element-infused sweep in front of you. The last move of a chain slams everything around you.

forms.name: Whirl
forms.text: A spin that hits everything around you for 1.5 s while you keep moving.

forms.name: Ward
forms.text: A bubble that absorbs 25% of your max life for 6 s, then bursts with its element.

forms.name: Repel
forms.text: A pulse that knocks the foes around you back and chills them.

forms.name: Armor
forms.text: Take 35% less damage for 8 s. Melee attackers take element damage and its status.

forms.name: Surge
forms.text: For 6 s everything you do runs 30% faster: attacks, your step, cooldowns, beats, wind-ups, mana and charge, and your dodge coming back. Basic hits also apply the element's stacks.

forms.name: Blink
forms.text: Dash 5 units, untouchable for a moment, leaving a trail that hits foes.

forms.name: Nova
forms.text: A huge blast all around you.

forms.name: Onslaught
forms.text: Dart between foes in the target area, striking several times; untouchable while darting, then 30% less damage taken for 2 s.

forms.name: Barrage
forms.text: Seven impacts rain over the target area.

forms.name: Maelstrom

melee.text: A storm round you that moves with you, hitting everything inside for 6 s.

forms.text: A lingering storm at the target that hits everything inside for 6 s.

fire.text: Burns, hotter with every stack, and blasts 30% wider.
fire.defensive: Burns attackers; Surge hits always burn.

frost.text: Chills, slower with every stack; 3 stacks freeze.
frost.defensive: Chills attackers; Surge hits always chill.

storm.text: Shocks: more damage taken with every stack; hits jump to 1 more foe.
storm.defensive: Shocks attackers; Surge hits always shock.

earth.defensive: 20% less damage taken on top; staggers attackers.

shadow.text: Hexes: more damage taken with every stack; heals you for 8% of the damage.
shadow.defensive: Hexes attackers, and +10% lifesteal while active.

nature.defensive: Poisons attackers, and regenerates 3% max life per second while active.

fusions.name: Steam
fusions.text: Scalding steam: wider, and blinds what it hits.

fusions.name: Magma
fusions.text: Leaves burning ground for 3 s and knocks foes back.

fusions.name: Hellfire
fusions.text: Brands foes: branded foes explode when they die.

fusions.name: Wildfire
fusions.text: Nature feeds the flames: bigger, harsher blasts that land less precisely and leave burning ground.

fusions.name: Superconductor
fusions.text: Hits arc to 1 more foe; chill and shock together set up Superconduct.

fusions.name: Glacier
fusions.text: Freezes outright and pierces, for 10% less damage.

fusions.name: Rimebloom
fusions.text: Leaves a chilling, poisoning thicket for 3 s.

fusions.name: Magnetism
fusions.text: Pulls foes together before the hit lands.

fusions.name: Void
fusions.text: Hits arc to 2 more foes and heal you for 5% of the damage.

fusions.name: Spore Storm
fusions.text: Poison rides the lightning: hits arc to 2 more foes, for 10% less damage.

fusions.name: Grave
fusions.text: Heavier hits that knock foes back and heal you for 6% of the damage.

fusions.name: Overgrowth
fusions.text: Roots foes in place for 1.5 s.

fusions.name: Plague
fusions.text: When a foe dies, its poison and hex spread to foes nearby.

reactions.name: Melt
reactions.text: Fire and Frost meet: the hit deals double damage.

reactions.name: Shatter
reactions.text: Earth and Frost meet: Earth shatters a frozen foe, or Frost a rattled one, for massive bonus damage.

reactions.name: Overload
reactions.text: Fire and Storm meet: the foe explodes, hitting everything nearby.

reactions.name: Superconduct
reactions.text: Frost and Storm meet: the foe freezes solid.

reactions.name: Soulfire
reactions.text: Fire and Shadow meet: part of the damage heals you.

reactions.name: Combust
reactions.text: Fire and Nature meet: the hit detonates, blasting everything around the foe.

reactions.name: Blight
reactions.text: Shadow and Nature meet: the foe's poison and hex spread to its neighbours.

reactions.name: Obsidian
reactions.text: Fire and Earth meet: obsidian hardens around you, a barrier worth half the hit.

reactions.name: Lightning Rod
reactions.text: Storm and Earth meet: the charge grounds through you, giving back a dodge and quickening your step.

reactions.name: Sunder
reactions.text: Earth and Shadow meet: the foe is sundered, taking more damage from every hit that follows.

reactions.name: Seedling
reactions.text: Earth and Nature meet: a healing seedling sprouts where the foe stands.

reactions.name: Siphon
reactions.text: Frost and Shadow meet: motes of mana tear loose from the foe and fly to you.

reactions.name: Crystallize
reactions.text: Frost and Nature meet: the foe crystallizes for heavy damage, and the shards chill foes nearby.

reactions.name: Blackout
reactions.text: Storm and Shadow meet: a cloud of darkness blinds the foe and everything near it.

reactions.name: Galvanize
reactions.text: Storm and Nature meet: your abilities surge, charging up and cooling down faster.

masteries.name: Inferno
masteries.text: Burning foes spread their flames when they die.

masteries.name: Permafrost
masteries.text: Freezes last 50% longer, and frozen foes take 30% more damage.

masteries.name: Tempest
masteries.text: Every chain jumps to 2 more foes, and shock's damage bonus doubles.

masteries.name: Night's Embrace
masteries.text: Killing a hexed foe heals you for 4% of your max life.
